environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, and (3) a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching field QUERY_STRING with patterns including `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|select\s+.*\s+from|insert\s+into|delete\s+from|drop\s+table|;\s*(?:drop|alter|create|truncate))` with action BLOCK and priority 2. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch logging is enabled for the WebACL. Additionally, the ECS task role has no outbound internet access (VPC with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints except ECR for image pull), preventing DNS-based or HTTP-based data exfiltration channels for blind SQLi techniques.

config.network: private subnet, no NAT gateway, no internet egress
config.runtime: Python 3.11, Flask 3.0, gunicorn on ECS Fargate
